title: 获奖来源外站技术产品详情与证据分级
scope: Awwwards-linked external inner page; specific award status requires official evidence
goal: 核对产品身份、示例尺寸与性能证据，选择示意配置并生成本地项目简报。
workflow: 辨认详情任务，不按 collection 路径误分为集合页
核实面板切换、预设状态和实际滚动容器
区分示例尺寸、未知性能与带文档输入
用键盘选择面板、饰面和示意布局
生成本地简报并说明未提交任何询价
failure_recovery: 数据失败保留完整静态四节与下载；未知性能不能记为零或认证；编辑后废弃旧简报。
motion_contract: 默认静态原创图示，无自动视频；减弱动态时无装饰运动；二维配置示意不冒充工程或三维配置器。
source_relationship_note: An outbound work-detail association does not certify that every current inner page won an award or matches a historical version.
evidence_note: Only recorded observations are facts. DOM structure does not prove visual composition, hidden state, source code, backend behavior or licenses. The runnable blueprint is an original recipe, not a source-site clone.

数据失败保留完整静态四节与下载；未知性能不能记为零或认证；编辑后废弃旧简报。

320、390、768、1440 宽度不出现整页横溢出；必要表格在独立区域滚动。
键盘可进入、操作、关闭对话框并返回触发点；错误不只靠颜色。
本地预览不得暗示真实支付、投稿、消息、账户或预约已生效。
limitations: Source interaction audit is not automatically performed
Real backend, production and physical-device acceptance are not included

technical_contract.implementation: Original fictional Folio display system, text, symbolic SVG/CSS diagrams and local text downloads
technical_contract.navigation: Accessible manual information tabs with roving arrows/Home/End; original source only evidenced four native panel buttons
technical_contract.dimensions: Positive integer example millimetres; display conversion does not alter input; null depth remains unknown
technical_contract.performance: Unknown value and reference stay null; zero is valid only when explicitly supplied as example or documented input; references do not certify truth
technical_contract.selection: Native labeled finish and symbolic layout radios; URL restores known selection; invalid links fall back with warning
technical_contract.brief: On-device text file only; no quotation request, message, order, inventory or engineering promise
technical_contract.editing: Run python render_static.py after product.json edits; exact data digest gates enhancement; complete static content remains on failure
not_reproduced: Source manufacturer data, diagrams, photos, video or certification
